title: La integración pendiente: Fronteras amazónicas y diálogo panamericano
goal: Analyze the historical isolation of Belize and the Guianas, CARICOM multilateralism, Brazilian border bridges (Takutu, Oyapock), and environmental treaties (OTCA).

sections.title: Unit 9: The Guianas & Belize — Lesson 5
body: Welcome to lesson 5 of Unit 9 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Belize, Suriname & The Guianas: Multilingual Frontiers.
In this lesson, we study la integración pendiente: fronteras amazónicas y diálogo panamericano, evaluating physical geomorphology, maroon resistance, linguistic pluralism, and geopolitics.

items: Analyze the historical isolation of Belize and the Guianas, CARICOM multilateralism, Brazilian border bridges (Takutu, Oyapock), and environmental treaties (OTCA).
Master the lexicon and discourse of integracion-caricom-fronteras-amazonicas.
